VoltWise estimates your monthly electricity bill using block tariff rates. Enter the month, the electricity used and your rebate, and it works out the total charges and the final cost after rebate. Every estimate is stored offline on your phone so you can review, edit or delete it later.

1. Choose the month
Tap the Month field and pick January to December. The current month is selected for you.

2. Enter electricity used
Type the units in kWh, a whole number from 1 to 1000. A red message appears under the field if the value is missing or out of range.

3. Set your rebate
Drag the Rebate slider from 0% to 5% in steps of 0.5%.

4. Calculate
Tap Calculate. The total charges, rebate amount and final cost appear on the same page, with a breakdown of each tariff block.

5. Save
Tap Save to History to store the result in the phone\'s local database.

6. View saved bills
Tap the clock icon in the title bar. The list shows each month and its final cost.

7. Edit or delete
Tap a month in the list to see all details. Tap Edit to change the values (the amounts are recalculated) or Delete to remove the record.

Tariff rates
First 200 kWh: 21.8 sen/kWh
Next 100 kWh (201–300): 33.4 sen/kWh
Next 300 kWh (301–600): 51.6 sen/kWh
Next 400 kWh (601–1000): 54.6 sen/kWh

Final cost = Total charges − (Total charges × Rebate %)
